header.title: Scanner test.
header.subtitle: Proving we can swap the current scanner for the licensed TradingView Trading Terminal, with our market data and our indicators on top.

about.title: What this page does
about.body: The chart below is the self-hosted TradingView Trading Terminal v31.2.0 bundle, the same product that runs at tradingview.lovfx.com. It loads from /charting_library/ on this domain and pulls market data through the existing /api/market-data/candles route.
about.note: This is a feasibility test, not a launch. Save and load, broker order entry, and account manager panels are intentionally disabled. Built-in studies (MACD, RSI) load on mount to prove the indicator API works.

verify.title: What to check
verify.item1: Chart renders with candles for EUR/USD on the 60-minute timeframe.
verify.item2: Toolbar shows drawing tools, indicator picker, timeframe selector, replay button.
verify.item3: MACD and RSI appear as separate panels under the candles.
verify.item4: Symbol search opens and returns the small built-in catalogue.

status.errorBody: Check the browser console. Most likely a missing bundle file under /charting_library/bundles/.
